encoding.layout: 8-bit greyscale, 4 * size wide: R0 G0 B0 A0 R1 ... per row; markings_low_<tile>.png the same at lowSize (phones)
encoding.ra: 1 + the row of `markings` reaching the texel (R low, A high byte; 0 none)
encoding.g: lane bits: 1 cycle lane along this side's kerb (2 its line solid, 128 at 2.25 m), 4 centre-line road (16 solid, 32 lane lines too), 8 a kerb line within 2 m and a texel's diagonal, 64 a red cycle surface
encoding.b: 128 + 20 * the signed distance (m) to the carriageway's middle
encoding.markings: [cx, cy, angle, halfLength, halfWidth, kind]: the centre in m from the tile's north-west corner (x east, y north), the axis across the road (rad from east, ccw), half the extent across and along the road
